vizinhos.14: And when she looked, behold, the king stood by a pillar, as the manner was, and the princes and the trumpeters by the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets: and Athaliah rent her clothes, and cried, Treason, Treason.
vizinhos.16: And they laid hands on her; and she went by the way by the which the horses came into the king’s house: and there was she slain.

anteriores.texto: Ela viu, e eis que o rei estava em pé junto à coluna, conforme o costume; os oficiais e as trombetas estavam junto ao rei. Todo o povo da terra se alegrava e tocava as trombetas. Então Atalia rasgou suas roupas e gritou: “Conspiração! Conspiração!”
